description: Micro-corpus for the E13-A.2 spike. Every observation is shaped [operator, arg1, arg2, output]. Three independent operator families (O, AND, NOR) each contribute a swapped-argument pair, mirroring the source discussion's K3-02 example and its E2 cross-domain generalization test. A non-commutative counter-example, a contradiction probe, and a genuinely unseen holdout pair are included so the spike can measure real generalization and correct rejection, not just replay a worked example.

non_commutative_counter_example.note: SUB is not commutative: swapping the arguments changes the output (D1 != D2). compare() must return None here -- no permutation can hold the output frozen while reconciling arg1/arg2, so the swap pattern must not be force-fitted.

contradiction_probe.note: Same O-family shape as S2 (arguments B, A) but a DIFFERENT output (D instead of C). Applying the O-family local pattern (discovered from S1/S2) to this observation's arguments predicts C; the actually observed output is D. Must be recorded as CONTRADICTED without discarding S1/S2's support.

holdout.note: Never used to discover or abstract any pattern -- reserved solely to test whether the pattern generalized across O/AND/NOR also holds for a fourth, entirely unseen operator.
